sql: select t.kalshi_order_id, t.trigger, count(*) n, count(t.contracts_ahead) readable, min(t.captured_at)::text first_at, max(t.captured_at)::text last_at, max(o.status) status, max(o.filled_at)::text filled_at, max(o.canceled_at)::text canceled_at from live_order_queue_ticks t join live_orders o on o.id = t.live_order_id where t.captured_at between timestamptz '2026-09-17 03:40:00+00' and timestamptz '2026-09-17 03:50:00+00' group by t.kalshi_order_id, t.trigger order by t.kalshi_order_id, n desc
